Newsletter February 2024

Dear members,

Happy New Year!

Lets make it a great one

 

Max Jansdam 

Secretary of Blueshell

 

 

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • Half year GMM announcement
  • This were December and Januari
  • What is coming up in Februari

­

Half year GMM

Dear members of Blueshell.

On tuesday the 6th of February 19:00, we will be having out Half year General Members' Meeting (GMM). The GMM will be held at Drienerlolaan 5, 7522NB Enschede at the Spiegel building, Room SP3. For more details, please read the mail that was send about the GMM.


Hope to see you all there, 
The 7th board.

­

How were the Last months?

December

December and Januari were pretty calm months for blueshell. 

LegaCie Bring Your Own Dinner night

Gift exchange Gamenight

­

Upcoming in February

The Weekly gamenights organised by the board continue! Be sure to come by the lounge and have a drink (They might not all be listed below, but are every monday). 

Committee events are happening. Be sure to check them out

 
­

Esports

The first split has come to an end. Playoffs are are done. Some are still doing promotions. Lets see how our teams did in the past months.

 

Rocket League

Blueshell Turtles 

Even Turtles started their Playoffs strong by beating Tadpoles 4-0, but it went down from there. Though they lost their last game of playoffs, the Turtles made it into the promotion tournament. Here they put up a good fight against our Squirtles, but did not manage to beat them. In their last game they brought it back and beat Dorans BackBoard.

BS Oogway

They did not play. :( I was wrong in the last Newsletter and Oogway did not make it into Playoffs last minute.

BS Squirtles

THEY WON!!! (played 1 game against Turtles and won. That is all.)

BS Tadpoles

Tadpoles fell in December after flying too high. They lost their playoff games and are out of the competition.

 

League of Legends 

BS Scaling

They won everything in Playoffs and promotion even when they were not trying to promote. 

 

BS Housecats

Lost playoffs :(

 

Valorant

Bs Tempra

No games played since last time.

SpicyWater and IcyWater

SpicyWater lost to Tism making them drop out of playoffs, but got a bottle of jäger from the short king of Dorans Tism. Meanwhile IcyWater won the rest of playoffs! They are not doing to well in the promotion tournament tho. Wish them luck!

 

CS2

HyperS

Ended on top of division 2 leaderboard

Lost to ETT in playoffs :( (Congrats Yannick) 

Now in promotion tournament.

+ Jonas
